5: From that it states, "in My wrath," it implies that I can ask about [its annulment] - as it was because of My wrath, and I did not swear with a calm mind. We can learn from here that we annul [the vow] for one who finds a hole in his vow, sayin, "I did not make the vow with this in mind - that what I see coming to me because of my vow, would come to me."
